Highlights
Experience the beauty and thrill of the El Tatio Geysers
Observe the contrast between the colors of the geysers' steam and the sunrise
Discover a lagoon full of flamingos
See the flora and fauna of the Putana Valley
Enjoy an inclusive breakfast as well as hotel pickup
Full description
Experience the breathtaking Tatio Geysers, located at over 4,300 meters (14,100 ft) above sea level, where hundreds of steam columns rise at sunrise, creating one of the most spectacular natural shows in the Atacama Desert.

During the tour, you'll admire stunning Andean landscapes, observe native wildlife, and enjoy a delicious breakfast surrounded by the mountains.

Highlights

✔ Sunrise at the Tatio Geysers

✔ Breakfast included

✔ Andean wildlife (vicuñas, flamingos, and foxes)

✔ Comfortable transportation

✔ Professional guide

Recommendation

Due to its high altitude, this tour is recommended for the end of your itinerary, after your body has had time to acclimatize to the altitude. We suggest taking it as one of your last tours in San Pedro de Atacama for a more comfortable experience.

Perfect for

Travelers who want to visit one of the most iconic attractions in the Atacama Desert.

Know before you go
IMPORTANT: **The park does not allow the entry of children under 9 years of age.**
We recommend taking other low-altitude tours before this tour, so you can acclimatize and avoid altitude sickness.
The deposit must be paid in advance at the agency in cash.
Dress in layers and wear something like a T-shirt underneath your warm clothes due to the drastic temperature changes from early morning to midday
The mornings at the geysers are always cold, no matter the time of year, so make sure you bring warm clothing. (-10, -5 degrees)
Pick up between 4:30 AM and 5:10 AM (may vary, exact time will be confirmed before the tour)
The included pickup service is not carried out in accommodations located outside the urban area of San Pedro de Atacama.
We do not pick up from accommodations located in ayllus close to San Pedro de Atacama (Quitor, Yaye, Checar, Sequitor, Solor and Coyo) or from accommodations in the town of Toconao.
Tour ends between 11:00 AM and 11:40 PM at Plaza Touristour
